info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Financial Instrument Valuation Models API
info.description: The Update Financial Instrument Valuation Models API allows users to modify existing financial valuation models within the banking sector. This API is essential for financial analysts and developers who need to ensure that the models reflect the latest market conditions and regulations. By utilizing this endpoint, clients can update parameters, assumptions, or calculations associated with distinct valuation models identified by a unique parameter. It facilitates continuous improvement and accuracy in financial decision-making processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific financial instrument valuation model identified by its resource ID. Provide the necessary data in the request body to modify the existing attributes as required.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the financial instrument valuation model identified by RES-100045. It contains the necessary data to modify the attributes of the existing model, ensuring that the updates are in accordance with the defined schema.

200.description: Request was successfully processed and the resource was updated.
